question: Who writes the commanded speed at *(unit+73Ch) +24h/+28h, and what do the director's command stages do with it?
answer: The block is the unit's `navigatorParams` (the literal string at 00D094C4). Two Lua bindings write the pair with an identical store: luaMW_SetShipSpeed 00890D30 and luaMW_NavigatorMoveOnPath 008A3600. +24h is max(requested, 0) and +28h is the mission clock DAT_00F876A4, not a boolean enable. The pair makes the weapon director's idle tail at 00836DC9 re-issue `cruise` instead of `stop`, and it ends a standing `stop` at 00836A8B. 00835BF0 (director vtable 6Ch) drops it once it is more than one second old.

search.method: A Capstone forward scan over the disk PE .text from every `MOV r32,[r32+73Ch]` and every `MOV r32,[r32+0AB0h]` (the only cached copy of the block pointer, made at 009F11A4 into the ship AI controller), tracking the loaded register through moves, spills and calls for a 250-instruction window and reporting every 4-byte store to +24h or +28h.
search.result: Six store sites, five functions, listed under `producers`. A second scan reported every call that receives the block pointer as `this` or as a stack argument: only BSP_GameSettings_GetSingleton (a coincidence of register reuse), _free in the destructor, and the two stripped property-registration bodies 009D5DF0 and 009D5E00. Nothing else can reach the block.
search.caveat: The scan cannot see a producer that reaches the block through a pointer cached at a displacement other than 73Ch or 0AB0h. No third cache site was found, but that is a bounded search, not a proof.

corrections.was: docs/CRUISE_COMMAND.md: the producer of +24h is `contract: unread`, and luaMW_LandConvoySetSpeed and luaMW_SquadronSetSpeed are the only SetSpeed bindings in the image
corrections.is: luaMW_SetShipSpeed at 00890D30 and luaMW_NavigatorMoveOnPath at 008A3600 both write the pair. luaMW_LandConvoySetSpeed writes convoy+368h through 00741140 and luaMW_SquadronSetSpeed calls member->vtable[3Ch] per squadron member.

corrections.was: docs/CRUISE_COMMAND.md: +28h is an enable, >= 0.0f active and -1.0f inactive
corrections.is: The stored value is the mission clock DAT_00F876A4. 00835C28 subtracts it from the clock and compares the difference with 1.0f, so it is a timestamp with a one-second age test. The >= 0.0f reading of the consumers is still right.
The store is at 009E13F8, in the arm that starts at 009E13B4. 009E11C6 is not an instruction start; the instruction covering it is CMP byte ptr [ECX+184h],BL at 009E11C2.

corrections.is: The arm belongs to the `stop` command 00E08F88 only, and raises when any of three holds: more than one slot filled, the unit IS player-controlled, or the pair is active.
